Here is the weekly ASX X (Twitter) thread for the week of 2 November 2026:

Post 1

ASX closed at 8,412 pts last week and the question this week is simple: can risk appetite hold while the RBA keeps its options open? Mixed global signals make this a week for selectivity, not conviction. Cautious lean. #ASX #ausbiz #macro

Post 2

🏦 Banks face margin pressure as rate cut expectations get repriced. ⛏️ Mining watches China PMI follow-through — iron ore near USD 98/t keeps the sector on edge. Two sectors, two catalysts, one week to sort it out. #ASX #banking #ironore #mining

Post 3

📉 Watch the resources space closely — BHP is the bellwether. Iron ore at USD 98/t and a softer AUD at 0.6380 compress margins and set the tone for the whole sector this week. #ASX #mining #BHP #ironore

Post 4

S&P 500 closed at 5,841 pts Friday. US 10-yr yields hovering near 4.35% keep pressure on growth valuations globally. What Wall Street does Monday morning sets the ASX open — and right now the signal is mixed. #ASX #ausbiz #SP500 #globalmarkets

Post 5

RBA decision Tuesday is the week's pivot point. Market pricing sits near 68% chance of no change. A hawkish hold lifts AUD and pressures rate-sensitives. A dovish signal rallies REITs and banks hard. Which way are you positioned? #ASX #RBA #ausbiz #interestrates
